comparison.objective: Feed a flash-card laminating pouch sealed-edge first and square into a laminator, then release it to the rollers.
comparison.physical_skill: Detect pouch orientation, align a flexible sheet to a slot, initiate roller engagement, and release at the correct point.
comparison.success_condition: First bite is sealed-edge first and sufficiently square, pouch exits or is safely drawing through, and the gripper does not hold it after roller takeover; open-edge feeding jams and scores zero.
comparison.reason: PR-1717 tests orientation-sensitive flexible-sheet feeding into powered rollers. The candidate tests bimanual handling of a rigid screen and passive size-based separation of free rigid bodies.
